bagPolicy.summary: Sun Bowl Stadium does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking information specific to Sun Bowl Stadium is not detailed on the provided page. Visitors are advised to check the official website or contact the venue for the most accurate and up-to-date parking options and pricing.

rideshare.note: All Uber, Lyft, taxis, and limos will be dropped off/picked up in lot RA-2. The ride share lot is lot RA-2, located on the corner of Randolph and Robinson.

concessions.note: The page does not provide specific details about food and drink options at Sun Bowl Stadium. It primarily focuses on event listings and venue information.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Sun Bowl Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Sun Bowl Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Sun Bowl Stadium. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Sun Bowl Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
